name: Bitaxe Sentry
description: Bitaxe Sentry is a monitoring and management solution for Bitaxe ASIC miners. Track the performance, temperature, and status of your miners from a single dashboard. Get alerts when your miners hit a new best difficulty, or when temperature or voltage thresholds are exceeded.
short_desc: Bitaxe stats and alerts, all in one
author: Zach Price

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
